description: HydraShield Benchmark Suite v1 — one case per ground-truth event (config/ground_truth_events.json). A case executes the model's OWN declared detector on the case window over real data (network at execution time, platform cache) and reports detection booleans + real values. 'passed' means the detector reproduced the expected REAL signal (defined from the dataset itself) inside the declared window — it is detection reproduction, NOT a skill score, and NOT a validation claim. key_required cases are never executed and never counted as failures.
pass_meaning: passed = the model's own detector found the expected real signal in the declared window on real fetched data. failed = the detector ran on real data and did not find the signal. key_required/error cases are neither.

detection.method: heat spell detector of src/climate/hazards/heat.py: >=3 consecutive days with daily Tmax above the location's own day-of-year 90th percentile (±7-day pool, 1991-2020 baseline), applied to the ERA5 daily Tmax series via src/dashboard/real_data.fetch_daily_climate; thresholds computed with src/climate/hazards/_series.doy_thresholds, spells with _series.detect_spells

cases.expected: A heat spell overlapping the window 2022-07-15..2022-07-25 by >=1 day at London (51.5074, -0.1278).
cases.pass_criteria: spell detected overlapping window by >=1 day

detection.method: flood signal machinery of src/climate/hazards/flood.py: ERA5 daily precipitation (fetch_daily_climate) 7-day rolling totals (_series.rolling_sums) percentile-ranked against the location's own ~10-year daily record (_series.percentile_rank of daily values context), AND GloFAS daily river discharge (fetch_flood_discharge) percentile (_series.percentile_rank within the location's own ~10-year series) per day in window

cases.expected: At the Ahr valley point (50.54, 6.99), window 2021-07-12..2021-07-20: a 7-day precipitation total ending in the window at >=90th percentile of the location's own record, AND >=1 day with GloFAS discharge at >=90th percentile of the location's own series, both within the window.
cases.pass_criteria: 7-day precipitation total percentile >=90 ending in window AND discharge percentile >=90 on >=1 day in window

detection.method: wind-gust percentile machinery of src/climate/hazards/wind.py: per-day day-of-year percentile of ERA5 daily wind-gust maxima vs the ±7-day pool of the 1991-2020 baseline (_series.doy_window_pool + _series.percentile_rank), applied via fetch_daily_climate on the window days

cases.expected: At London (51.5074, -0.1278): >=1 day in the window 2022-02-17..2022-02-19 with gust maximum at >=95th day-of-year percentile.
cases.pass_criteria: >=1 day with DOY gust percentile >=95 in window

detection.method: drought anomaly machinery of src/climate/hazards/drought.py: 90-day precipitation sum ending 2022-08-31 vs same-calendar 90-day windows of the prior ~10 years (_series.window_sums_by_year + _series.standardized_anomaly), plus dry-spell detection (<1 mm, >=10 consecutive days, _series.detect_spells) on the window days, via fetch_daily_climate

cases.expected: At SW Iberia (37.6, -6.5): 90-day standardized anomaly z <= -0.8 at 2022-08-31, AND >=1 dry spell fully or partially inside the window 2022-06-01..2022-08-31.
cases.pass_criteria: z <= -0.8 for the 90-day window ending 2022-08-31 AND dry-spell presence in window

detection.method: Wildfire benchmark family: FWI series (src/prediction/fwi.py) over event windows derived from real NASA FIRMS detections (src/climate/fire_events.py). Not executable without FIRMS_MAP_KEY; no events are fabricated.

cases.pass_criteria: not executable until FIRMS_MAP_KEY is configured and real FIRMS-derived events exist
